_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 74: 19-24 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He applies Jeremiah 24 to America, saying those people faced war, famine, disease and destruction because they did not turn back to God, that God has given America a window and is watching what the church does with it, that the midterm vote is important or the country goes socialist as other places did, and that the warning covers the fires, wars, pestilence, plagues and major storms he sees.
mentions.quote: warn you about the fires and all this stuff I see and the wars
mentions.falsify_match: A socialist turn after the midterms, alongside fires, wars, disease and major storms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None available. The list is broad enough that fires, wars, disease and storms occur in any year, and the socialist turn is conditioned on how people vote.

mentions.claim_text: He says an earthquake takes place over the Mount of Olives and he saw it split in a bad earthquake, that the Lord pointed to an olive tree covered in ripe olives rather than the usual fig tree as the sign of the time frame, that his son said this happens in September or October which would be Rosh Hashanah, and that he does not believe it is this year, does not know, and does not have a date.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking of that mountain and the Lord said it will happen
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake splitting the Mount of Olives.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake, but no year is claimed. He says outright that he does not have a date, does not believe it is this year and does not want to add to or take away from it, so the September or October window comes from his son and carries no year. Recorded without a window for that reason.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the UN and was told to pray concerning the general assembly with all the nations coming in September, that this is the end of September, that Rosh Hashanah falls on the 11th which is 911, and that they are praying over this time frame again for something major.
mentions.quote: Rashana is on the 11th is 911. So, we're praying over this time frame
mentions.falsify_match: A major incident at or around the UN General Assembly in September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet assembly. The date is reached by lining up Rosh Hashanah with the digits 911, which is a numerological link rather than a stated one.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a vision with the president gone and a woman over eight months pregnant standing in the Oval Office, that JD Vance took over the White House during her pregnancy, that she was not publicly pregnant when he saw it, that the Lord said to pray because they are going to try to take out the president, and that it did not happen, the baby is here and they did their job.
mentions.quote: the Lord said pray they're going to try to take out the president
mentions.falsify_match: The president removed and Vance succeeding him during the pregnancy.
mentions.falsify_miss: The forecast event did not occur, and he says so on air. He then scores it as a hit twice over: the non-removal is credited to prayer, and the pregnancy, which he concedes he cannot confirm was underway when he saw it, is offered as the confirming detail. Nothing in either direction can count against the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as he prayed he saw another 911 disturbance and SIM cards rebuilt in New York, a plot and a plan with the SIM cards again to disrupt the 911 service, that it is in another building and they have rebuilt it, that the one found on the 23rd of September has a new counterpart already reestablished and ready, and separately that he saw a terrace and mirrored aviator glasses.
mentions.quote: A plot, a plan uh with the SIM cards again to disrupt the 911 service
mentions.falsify_match: A second SIM farm found in New York aimed at emergency services.
mentions.falsify_miss: No second site. The 23 September find it builds on is a real reported event, so the base claim rests on news already public; the new detail is that another one is already in place, which is checkable. The aviator glasses image carries no claim at all.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip in which an official is asked what will happen if the Israeli prime minister comes to New York in September for the UN General Assembly, given a campaign pledge to order his arrest under an International Criminal Court warrant, and the official answers that he believes the prime minister is a war criminal charged by the court.
mentions.quote: What will happen if he comes in September?
mentions.falsify_match: An arrest attempt in New York in September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempt. This is another person's stated intention played from a clip, not something he says he saw, and it should not be counted to his record either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not just about America, that he saw an attack worse than October the 7th happening in the middle of the night using chemical weapons against the Jewish people in Israel, that it will be a major thing, that he saw it happening with boils and convulsing, that it was awful what happened to children and families in the days ahead, and that he prays they stop it.
mentions.quote: an attack worse than October the 7th happening in the middle of the night
mentions.falsify_match: A night-time chemical attack in Israel with casualties exceeding October 7th.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No date is given, only the days ahead, and prayer is offered as the reason it may not happen. The chemical and night-time details are specific enough to be checked if it ever does occur.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray for Byron, that he saw a scandal coming with JD and had mentioned the Nixon thing, that the Lord kept saying this will be a new modern-day whitewatergate and Watergate 2028, that they will try to do that, and that he saw JD pulling back while Byron tried to rise up.
mentions.quote: the Lord kept saying this will be a new modern-day whitewater whitewatergate
mentions.falsify_match: A 2028 scandal touching JD Vance, with Byron Donalds gaining as Vance recedes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No scandal and no such shift. A third named figure is added here, which narrows the claim further and makes it more checkable than the earlier tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not want to be flaky or add to the prophetic confusion and weirdness of 2020, that back then everybody was saying and thinking President Trump was going to win and he lost, that when asked he said outright he is going to lose and will not win, and that he remembers hearing it in July.
mentions.quote: He's going to lose. He's not going to win.
mentions.falsify_match: A July 2020 recording in which he says the president will lose.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recording, or a 2020 recording saying the opposite. This is a claim about his own past output and is checkable against it, though 2020 sits outside this corpus. He raises it while warning against prophetic weirdness, which makes the self-citation the point of the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned him that in 2027, 2028 and 2029 there will be socialistic control concerning the internet, that they will grab hold of Facebook and the other platforms and try to control what people are able to say and hear concerning the First Amendment, and that he saw a spider putting a web around it.
mentions.quote: 2027, 2028, 2029, you'll see socialistic control concerning the internet
mentions.falsify_match: Government control of speech on the major platforms across those three years.
mentions.falsify_miss: None workable. Platform moderation disputes are continuous, so almost any three-year span supplies something that fits.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is cleaning up the pastors because there is stench before him, stench in the church behind the pews and behind the pulpits like a soiled diaper, and that he is cleaning up his church right now, that acceleration will come between July all the way to the first, that they should watch midpoints, and that he was warned about September the 11th.
mentions.quote: acceleration will come between uh July all the way to the 1st
mentions.time_phrase: July all the way to the 1st, watch midpoints
mentions.falsify_match: Exposures among pastors accelerating across the window, with something on 11 September.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The first of what is never said, so the window's end is a guess, and watch midpoints adds a second undefined marker. This is the third distinct timing given for the church cleansing inside a month.

mentions.claim_text: He says 43 people gave their heart to Jesus tonight, the biggest altar call of the week, with 2026 yesterday and 39 the day before, asks when the general assembly is, says they will pray for the 22nd to the 26th because it is very serious, and that he saw an attack trying to come against the general assembly in New York.
mentions.quote: an attack trying to come against the general assembly uh in in New York
mentions.falsify_match: An attack or attempted attack on the UN General Assembly between 22 and 26 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing happens in those five days. This is the tightest window given for the September UN material and the easiest of them to score. The salvation counts in the same breath are separately checkable against the ministry's own tallies.
